scope: SYNTHETIC OFFLINE EXPERIMENT ONLY; no API/policy/model replacement or fraud efficacy claim
label_target: Synthetic SOURCE mule intent; never mixed with legacy transaction-intent labels

design.selection: Best epoch by validation BCE; threshold by validation FPR; three predeclared seeds, no winner chosen on test
design.neighborhood: Both models receive the same full supplied synthetic history, max 300 events; broader than current API's one-neighborhood query
design.evidence: Rule-only independent untrust; simulated chronological receipt time; non-rejected attempts are not settled payments
design.comparison: Frozen v1 has old transaction-intent training; retrained v1, v2 tabular and v2 graph share source-intent training data
design.limits: Same artificial generator across splits, no confirmed outcomes, no delayed/out-of-order receipt simulation, no production calibration
design.development: Exploratory experiment; all budgets and seeds are reported, no untouched confirmatory holdout claim
